thread:
Ravi (PM): Quick drop-in about Private Deploy roadmap: want alignment on installer presets, upgrade guarantees, and what we call 'beta'. Need firm launch gates for VPC/on‑prem networking.
Keiko (Eng): TL;DR we can support three installer modes but only two for beta. Technical constraints: preserving egress IPs during operator upgrades is fiddly if customers use SNAT pools.
Diego (Field SE): Field signal: customers care about two things — no outbound holes during install, and no surprise IPs after upgrade. They also want clear checklist to hand to netops.
Ravi (PM): Proposal — Beta supports: 1) NAT-first (default), 2) static-egress (IP-preserve). Relay/proxy mode is experimental (alpha). Beta must include an automated upgrade path that hits our downtime SLO.
Sami (Customer Success): Example ask from InsureCo: their compliance team requires certificate continuity across upgrades and an explicit rollback procedure. They also want an ops playbook for cert rotation rollback.
Keiko (Eng): Engineering design idea: operator rollout uses an "egress-preserve" migration strategy: new operator waits for dataplane handshake and validates source IPs before switching. Add `preserve-egress=true` toggle. Tradeoffs: longer upgrade window and double running dataplane.
Iris (Release): From release ops POV: need a gating matrix. For beta: automated canary + metric checks. Canary plan: 5% traffic, 1h burn, metrics: control-plane RTT, handshake errs, auth failures. Abort on >0.5% auth fails or RTT spike >150ms. Can deploy-bot enforce?
deploy-bot: Yes. We have a canary job template. Use `tools/canary_gate --pct=5 --duration=60m --rtt=150 --auth-fail=0.5`. Exits non-zero on failure.
Diego (Field SE): Docs: include a one-page NetOps handoff (IP verification commands, sample iptables rules for older kernels, how to validate SNI passthrough). Also sample terraform for static-egress NAT reservation.
Ravi (PM): Launch gates (beta) candidate list:
- Installer: presets `nat`, `static-egress` (both documented)
- Upgrade: automated preserve-egress flow validated with <=3m median disruption in lab runs
- Safety: rollback steps documented and automated `operator rollback` script exists
- Observability: console shows per-installation egress-ip, last-handshake-timestamp, and canary status
- Field: NetOps runbook + customer-facing comms ready
If any missing, ship alpha only.
Keiko (Eng): Estimates: runtime/handshake work + preserve flag ~= 2 sprints. Canary integration + gating hooks 1 sprint. Docs + field validation 1 sprint. Could be parallelized with 4 engineers.
Sami (Customer Success): I'll line up InsureCo and FinSecure as pilot customers once we have static-egress docs and the rollback script. I need a one pager on SLA impact.
Iris (Release): I'll add post-release quick checks to oncall playbook and reserve `privdeploy-beta` image tags. Also ask infra to hold a small capacity reservation for beta customers.
Keiko (Eng): Note: air-gapped installs (airgap bundle) are out of scope for this beta but we should document the expected gap and compatibility constraints so field teams can set expectations.
Diego (Field SE): Also include a short KMS note: customers who bring their own KMS will need local cert bundling steps during installer run. Add to runbook.
Ravi (PM): Action items:
- Keiko: design doc + `preserve-egress` flag spec by EOD Mon
- Diego: NetOps handoff draft + terraform sample by Wed
- Iris: create canary gating job and reserve image tags by Thu
- Sami: pilot comms + SLA one-pager by Thu EOD
We'll revisit in product review next week. Keep messages short in follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
